summary: Redesign the experimental list-page vertical slice into an intentional operational roster and establish visual-quality governance with semantic contrast pairs, WCAG 2.2 AA gates, AAA reporting, responsive geometry assertions, and approved screenshot baselines.

components: Preserve stable component APIs while validating danger-action text and control boundaries against WCAG 2.2 AA.
consumers: Provide an opt-in visual-audit skill and design-check commands; no consumer migration is required while the pattern remains experimental.
contracts: Expand the experimental list-page contract with owned result-row anatomy and add a visual-quality contract for contrast, geometry, viewport, and screenshot evidence.
documentation: Document the visual QA rubric, AA versus AAA policy, baseline approval workflow, and remediation format for AI agents and maintainers.
foundations: Add semantic composition-spacing and control-boundary roles, and correct AA contrast risks without renaming or removing existing tokens.
patterns: Replace the generic card gallery with a deliberate masthead, filter rail, result ledger, responsive row anatomy, empty state, and long-content behavior.
screenshots: Create candidate reference screenshots at 375px, 768px, and 1280px plus empty and long-content states; future diffs require explicit baseline review.

verticalSlice.name: Operational people roster
verticalSlice.workflow: Search and filter people, scan identity and assignment metadata, distinguish status, inspect long content, recover from empty results, and act at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.
verticalSlice.evidence: Experimental contract, redesigned Storybook stories, WCAG AA token audit, AAA report, responsive geometry tests, accessibility scan, candidate screenshot baselines, and human visual review.
